extracted.name: Dark Chocolate Mug/Ramekin Cake
extracted.description: I was looking for a quick and easy mug cake to whip up for a special occasion and to satisfy my chocolate cravings without all the calories. I chose to use stevia as a natural sweetener and apple sauce so that it is also oil free. Equipment - 5 oz ramekin Inspired by - thebigmansworld.com/100-calorie-chocolate-mug-cake/
instruction_lines: Grease the ramekin by wiping it a paper towel with a bit of oil
Add in the wet ingredients and combine well. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Bake for 8-10 minutes. Remove from the oven and let it rest for 30-seconds to a minute.
